issues.description: Field 'numberOfLecturers' has inconsistent types across artifacts: the problem statement UML declares numberOfLecturers as int (problem_statement.md lines 63-69). In the solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) the field is declared as 'private byte numberOfLecturers;' (line 9), the constructor parameter uses byte in the signature (line 13), and the setter accepts a byte parameter (line 50), while the getter is declared to return int ('public int getNumberOfLecturers()' at line 46). This mismatch (UML: int vs. solution field/params: byte, plus a getter returning int) can confuse students about the intended type and lead to divergent implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfLecturers consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to use int for the field, constructor parameter, and setter (i.e., 'private int numberOfLecturers;', constructor parameter int, setter parameter int) and keep the getter returning int, matching the UML. Alternatively, if a smaller numeric type was intentional, update the problem statement/UML to document 'byte' and update the getter signature to return byte to avoid mixed types.
